'''John Richard Evans''' (born August 5, 1949 in [[Los Angeles]]) is an American retired [[canoe slalom|slalom canoeist]] who competed from the late 1960s to the mid-1970s. He finished 14th in the [[Canoeing at the 1972 Summer Olympics – Men's slalom C-2|C-2 event]] at the [[1972 Summer Olympics]] in [[Munich]].
